scope: Bounded 100-update model-path diagnostic using 145 short deterministic synthetic dialogues. This is not a factual corpus, general Chinese conversation dataset, independent evaluation, or evidence of agent memory.
checks: The three generator templates and slot values were reviewed.
All 192 generated rows satisfy programmatic last-location and role-alternation invariants.
Train and development hold out selected object/place pairs; all 192 token sequences and masks were recomputed against source messages.
A small selection was read manually.
limitations: 145 training dialogues differ only by small sets of objects, locations, and three templates.
Development uses the same templates and vocabulary; held-out combinations alone cannot measure broad generalization.
No semantic overlap audit against every historical dataset or the final evaluation has been completed.
